title: LazySeries v1.3.0 shared contract and state version semantics
note: Byte-identical in both repositories. Defines the additive v1.3.0 state fields and the migration/version-refusal rules. Host-specific implementation and readiness claims live elsewhere and are not part of this shared contract.

execution_intent.description: Persisted separately from workflow mode and current stage. plan_only preserves the explicit plan-only state until the user actually requests execution; a mere file edit, quoted example, or ambiguous 'yes' with multiple pending questions cannot set this to execute.

workflow_mode.description: Unchanged internal mode selection (assisted|direct|planned|long-horizon|orchestrated). Kept internal; present by tier (small/medium/complex).

provisional.description: Later milestones may be provisional. A provisional milestone and its tasks MUST NOT dispatch.

parent_plan_id.description: Authoritative parent plan identifier for child plans.

dependency_links.description: Task/milestone dependency links; cycles and dangling links are rejected.

decision_ledger_schema.description: Versioned immutable event ledger for cross-plan decisions and corrections. See lazyseries-v130-scenarios.v1.json canonical_formats.decision_ledger.

old_state_readable.rule: States declaring a known major version (1.x) remain readable; missing additive fields default to their schema defaults (execution_intent=plan_only, milestone.provisional=false).

unknown_newer_major_version.rule: States declaring a major version greater than the implemented major version (e.g. 2.x when running 1.x) are REFUSED.
unknown_newer_major_version.diagnostic: unsupported state major version: found <found_major>.X but this runtime implements major <implemented_major>; migrate or upgrade before loading. Refusing to read newer state to avoid silent data loss.

same_major_additive.rule: Within the same major version, unknown additive fields are ignored (forward-compatible) but not required.

version_parsing.major_compare: only the MAJOR component gates refusal; MINOR/PATCH are additive within a major.
